Flaming Fist Jacek is a deceased Human Fighter who served the Flaming Fist at Waukeen's Rest.

Involvement

Act One

Jacek was one of the contingent of Flaming Fist soldiers accompanying  Duke Ulder Ravengard and stayed at Waukeen's Rest when it was attack. During the subsequent battle, he was killed. His body is at the entrance to Waukeen's Rest, alongside  Fist Recruit Ephren who mourns his loss and says a prayer. He cannot be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

Act Three

Later in Act Three in Highberry's Home, talking to  Molly the Orphan reveals that she is waiting for Jacek, her father, and that they had come to Baldur's Gate but he had to leave soon after.
